usedFor: humanitix sells event tickets, and Google Docs receives attendee details through “Add or Replace Text In Tab” after “New Attendes”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Attendes” in humanitix, then “Add or Replace Text In Tab” in Google Docs
bestTemplate.why: Each attendee created on an order is written into a document, so your attendee list builds itself.

watchOut: “Add or Replace Text In Tab” can replace a tab's content, so choose add or each attendee overwrites the last.
